name: sds-sentinel
description: Internal Discord server monitoring, moderation, security, and administration platform for Silver Dev Studios

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,bot -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @sds-sentinel/api" "npm run dev -w @sds-sentinel/bot"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sds-sentinel/shared -w @sds-sentinel/database -w @sds-sentinel/permissions -w @sds-sentinel/validation -w @sds-sentinel/discord-services -w @sds-sentinel/api -w @sds-sentinel/bot && npm run build -w @sds-sentinel/dashboard
